project_type: Static HTML/CSS/JS website - sibling apology simulator
build_system: None - pure static files, open index.html directly
test_framework: None - manual browser testing, validation via HTML structure checks
test_command: N/A - static site, verify file structure and syntax
verification_instructions: 1. Verify index.html, style.css, script.js, README.md exist. 2. Verify images/ directory exists. 3. Open index.html in browser to test all screens flow. 4. Validate no inline JS, no eval(), proper CSP meta tag.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Clone repo and open index.html in a browser.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external packages needed since pure HTML/CSS/JS. No build tools, no npm, no frameworks.
contribution_requirements: Deploy to GitHub Pages. No Node.js, React, Next.js, or backend. Must work by opening index.html directly.
key_patterns: Single page application using screen transitions via JS. Glassmorphism CSS with animated gradients. Mobile-first responsive design. No frameworks.
directory_structure: Root contains index.html, style.css, script.js, README.md. images/ folder for meme and memory gallery photos.
